expectations.text: Explains why loading a 2GB file into memory at once causes a heap-out-of-memory crash
expectations.evidence: "tries to pull the whole file into memory as one giant piece before it does anything with it... that heap has a size limit. Your 2GB file is bigger than that limit, so Node runs out of room and crashes"

expectations.text: Explains what streaming means in plain language
expectations.evidence: "streaming reads the file in small chunks, one small piece at a time... processes each chunk... then throws that piece away before grabbing the next chunk"
